One Night Ultimate Werewolf rules summary (Bezier Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose role cards: always {n} cards, three more than players
Shuffle and deal 1 facedown to each player; the other 3 facedown in the center
Everyone secretly looks at their card and puts it back facedown
One player is the Announcer and reads the night script (or use the app)

steps.note: Listed in the order they wake at night; the last three never wake.
details: Looks at another player's card and becomes that role and team
Seer, Robber, Troublemaker or Drunk: does that action right away; Werewolf or Mason: wakes with them; Minion: sees the Werewolves
As Insomniac, wakes again after the Insomniac
Wake together and see each other
Lone Wolf option: a lone Werewolf may look at one center card
Sees the Werewolves (they do not know him); on the werewolf team
If no players are Werewolves, wins if someone other than him dies
Always use both; wake and see each other (a missing one is in the center)
Looks at one other player's card or two center cards
May swap cards with another player and look at the new card; he is now that role but does not act
May swap two other players' cards without looking
Must swap his card with a center card without looking at it
Looks at her own card at the end of the night to see if it changed
Only wins if he dies; then the Werewolves do not win
If he dies, the player he points at dies too

steps.text: Your role at the end is the card in front of you, which may have changed; nobody looks at cards after the night
Night phase: roles wake in the script order
